left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adult men  [OR] and women over 50 years
  -  After fully hearing and fully understanding this clinical trials, those who agree to voluntarily decide to participate and to comply with the notice
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  If screening shows that the white blood cell(WBC) is less than 3000/㎕  [OR] or more than 8000/㎕
  -  Those who received influenza vaccination within 3 months before the screening
  -  Those who have a body mass index(BMI) of less than 18

5 kg / m2  [OR] or greater than 35 kg / m2 at the screening
  -  Those who have a clinically significant acute  [OR] or chronic cardiovascular system, [OR]  endocrine system, [OR]  immune system, [OR]  respiratory system, [OR]  liver biliary system, kidney  [OR] and urinary system, [OR]  neuropsychiatry, [OR]  musculoskeletal system, [OR]  inflammatory  [OR] and hematologic
  -  Those who take a medication  [OR] or health function food that affects your promotion of immunity within 1 month prior to the screening
  -  Those who have received antipsychotic medication within 3 months before screening
  -  Those who alcoholic  [OR] or drug abuse suspected
  -  Those who participated in other clinical trials within 3 months before screening
  -  Laboratory test by show the following results
       -  Aspartate Transaminase(AST), Alanine Transaminase(ALT) > Reference range 3 times upper limit
       -  Serum Creatinine > 2
